Prerequisite(s): Red Lotus Blade feat, BAB +9

Benefit: At 5 TP or more, you may spend all TP to deliver a special heavy blade attack that takes a place of an attack of a full-attack or just a single attack. This attack deals damage as normal and the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + half of your character level + your Strength modifier) or be stunned for 1 round. At 10 TP or more, you may spend all TP to cause the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 12 + half of your character level + your Strength modifier) or be stunned for 2 rounds. At 15 TP, you may spend all TP to cause the target must make a Fortitude save (DC 14 + half of your character level + your Strength modifier) or be stunned for 3 rounds.
